title: Portfolio Creation and Management
summary: A public portfolio and Content Library with local applications for creating, organizing, previewing, and maintaining their content.

content.business_need: Present complete project stories and organize reusable learning work while keeping content maintenance manageable.
content.audience: Portfolio visitors, learning designers, and the owner maintaining the sites.
learning_objectives: Explore project case studies and reusable learning resources.
Understand the distinct portfolio and library management workflows.
content.role: Interface design, development, content structure, and local management workflow design.
content.design_approach: Pair two purpose-built public experiences with local management tools for the different content tasks.
content.development_process: Built custom public HTML/CSS/JavaScript experiences and local content management, preview, validation, and publishing workflows.
outcomes: A public portfolio with custom case studies and interactive experiences.
A Content Library browsing interface with a separate local Library Manager.
Portfolio Manager supports project records, page copy, assets, references, and controlled publishing.

source_material_notes: Describes the public systems and local management workflows presented in the approved portfolio page.

related_work.relationship: A separate authoring product within Developer Space; creates learning interactions while these systems present and maintain content.
